solution: Since \(\vec{c}=-(\vec{a}+\vec{b})\), \(|\vec{c}|^2=|\vec{a}|^2+|\vec{b}|^2+2\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b} \Rightarrow 49=9+25+2\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b} \Rightarrow \vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=7.5\). So \(\cos\theta=\dfrac{7.5}{3\times5}=\dfrac{1}{2} \Rightarrow \theta=\dfrac{\pi}{3}=60^\circ\). [Textbook misprint: option C is printed as \(\pi/4\) (a duplicate/typo); the official Balbharati answer key confirms option B as correct, corrected here to the intended \(\pi/3\).]
